findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：閥門與消防栓市場成熟，終端用戶不易轉換品牌；鐵閘閥與消防栓主要對手為 McWane 與 American Cast Iron Pipe，僅少數競爭者。
findings.excerpt: The competitive environment for most of Water Flow Solutions’ valve products is mature and many end users are slow to transition to brands other than their historically preferred brands.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因子：除北美對手外，亦面臨北美以外廠商競爭，強度受匯率、運費與貿易救濟影響。
findings.excerpt: In addition to competition from United States and Canadian companies, we face the threat of competition from outside of North America.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 兩次搜尋（共2次）未找到2026份額消長數據或具名新進入者；搜尋摘要稱 FY2026 前九個月 Water Flow 銷售持平（量減價增）、Water Management 約+11%，但未讀頁面原文，不作 finding。
